context: Tests whether the skill reports schema drift and preserves the read-only boundary.

checklist.name: Drift identified
checklist.description: The response identifies both the unexpected Status options and all missing expected views

checklist.name: No reinterpretation
checklist.description: The response does not silently map Todo or In Progress to Radar semantics

checklist.name: No repair mutation
checklist.description: The response does not edit Project fields, options, views, or items

checklist.name: Actionable handoff
checklist.description: The response states the expected Inbox, Next, Now, Blocked, Done schema and requests explicit approval for any later repair
